description: Unit tests for the ReferralOrder class in the OpenMRS project, verifying cloning, copying, and revision behaviors.

classes.name: ReferralOrderTest
classes.description: Contains JUnit test methods for testing ReferralOrder class behaviors such as copying, revision, and discontinuing.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllReferralOrderFields
methods.description: Tests whether all fields of ReferralOrder are correctly copied by the copy() method.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Tests the cloneForRevision() method to ensure it copies all relevant fields appropriately.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Tests the cloneForDiscontinuing() method to verify correct setting of fields when discontinuing an order.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetTheRelevantFieldsForADCOrder
methods.description: Verifies that cloneForRevision() properly resets specific fields like action, dates, and accession number for an Order.
